doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: De De's favourite trumpet players
summary: Rene was his favourite, followed by Guy Kelly; they discuss Punch.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Now, who would be your favorite trumpet player as long as that time? Who was your name as some of the outstanding people?
Well, I said René. René was your favorite. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
And who was your name after René? Bass brother.

I know he didn't work with Punch, but I might have faint of hurt his playing like he's punching. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. And after the line was a fella called Guy Kelly. Mm-hmm. The trumpet man. Fast, you know, fast, fast. He didn't know what I mean. He was, he was still a scambler. Did Punch have his own band in those days? Well, I don't think he was in the regular line up. I don't think. Was he the leader then mostly? Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah.
